channel.title: The Real News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: DOJ under fire for withholding Epstein files related to alleged Trump child sex assault
item.description: “Covering up direct evidence of a potential assault by the president of the United States is the most serious possible crime in this White House,” said one Democratic congressman.

item.title: As Trump builds up to attack Iran, the Dem establishment—again—shows its support with silence
item.description: Feigned helplessness, process criticism, no public statements or editorials: Liberal elites continue to let Trump do their dirty work for them.

item.title: Jeffrey Sachs: After four years of war in Ukraine, the world order has changed dramatically
item.description: “The US thought, ‘We’re the hegemon, we’ll run the show.’ But, in fact, what we have is a bully in the United States—still very violent and very powerful, no doubt—and a vassal Europe that is utterly confused, demoralized, and divided.”

item.title: ICE is using the same Microsoft tech Israel uses to surveil and kill Palestinians
item.description: “A lot of the surveillance technology that's coming for us in North America is framed as ‘battle tested’ in Palestine.”

item.title: Hegseth demands Anthropic let military use AI however it wants—even for autonomous killer drones and spying on Americans
item.description: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth said the company that owns the AI assistant Claude would be punished unless it drops all ethical guidelines.

item.title: Cuba says men on Florida boat ‘intended to carry out an infiltration for terrorist purposes’
item.description: The Cuban Interior Ministry said it detained seven people involved in the plot, including one who “had allegedly been sent from the United States to facilitate the landing and reception of the armed group.”

item.title: The US and Israel push Iran—and the Middle East—to the brink
item.description: Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu, and the war hawks in their cabinets are pushing the Iranian regime to the point that surrender would be worse than war.

item.title: Trump says things are great for the uber-rich—but what about us? What about the Epstein Survivors?
item.description: Trump’s State of the Union address delivered grandstanding and grievance politics, but few concrete solutions for Americans facing healthcare crises, economic instability, and ever-widening inequality.

item.title: ‘Batshit authoritarianism’: Trump allies drafting order to give him ‘extraordinary power over voting’
item.description: “This is a plot to interfere with the will of voters and undermine both the rule of law and public confidence in our elections,” said Sen. Mark Warner.

item.title: Stolen wealth: how Black depositors funded the nation’s capital
item.description: D.C. elites siphoned $57 million—worth $1.5 billion today—from the Freedman’s Savings Bank to enrich themselves and fund the development of the District at the expense of formerly enslaved depositors.
